zh: 0.27.0 用了一天报上来的毛病都修了：项目不再被认错，模型不再挂着旧故障，搜索也更快。
偏好可以交给 AI 收拾；#FLG 讨论里，别的客户端粘一句话就能入席。
两台电脑在同一个网里，对一下六位数就能配上（默认关闭，Beta）。
en: A day of 0.27.0 is fixed: projects resolve right, stale model errors clear, search is faster.
An AI can tidy your preferences, and another client joins a #FLG discussion by pasting one sentence.
Two computers on one network pair by comparing six digits (off by default, Beta).
